summary: Fence native and fallback TUI terminal results by selection and generation, cancel superseded setup, and preserve failed/retry states across tab changes and phase timeouts.

replay.detail: Only process-local TUI attach state changes; no event replay changes.

schema.detail: No database or persisted state changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or member coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Internal Rust feed commands/results carry an attempt generation and terminal subscription IDs are generation-specific. No daemon wire schema or capability contract changes; all in-repository callers migrate together.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or additional service interruption is required.

manual.detail: No migration steps. Native/fallback failures and phase timeouts show a reason and Ctrl+R retry hint. Failed shells retain their reason on tab return and restart setup only on explicit retry.

recovery.detail: No persistent state is modified; replacing the TUI binary needs no data recovery.
